senses.gloss: ch. sameto read (after reciting from the Pentateuch). Targ. II Esth. III, 8 קרין בספריהון ומְתַרְגְּמִין בנביאיהון they read from their books (the Pentateuch) and recite (as Haftarah, v. פָּטַר) from their prophets.—

units: <cite ref="Gittin 68a:5">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <he>שדה ושדות</he>, <cite ref="Ecclesiastes 2:8">Koh. II, 8</cite>) <he>הכא תַרְגִּימוּ וכ׳</he> here (in Babylonia) they translate it &c.
<cite ref="Ketubot 110a:13">Keth. 110ᵃ</cite> <he>תַּרְגְּמָהּ</he> … <he>אליבא וכ׳</he> R. N., developing the opinion of R. Sh., explained it &c.; <cite ref="Shabbat 52b">Sabb. 52ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.
